answer_1.quote: the description generation task calls for generating referring expressions describing people in a text.

answer_2.quote: we measure precision of the generated description ... using BLEU (unigram), ROUGE-L and Bertscore.

answer_4.quote: We collect human annotations on a subset of 200 person entities in the validation set, with 3-4 annotations per entity. We ask crowdworkers on AMT ... to rate the contextual appropriateness of the two on a scale of 1-5.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare ground-truth descriptions with generated incongruous descriptions and rate contextual appropriateness on a 5-point scale.
